svg.aria-label: Standards, unknown and uncertainty propagation use one constructed dataset. A places the unknown within the standard range; B retains pointwise residuals; C propagates reading error with standard concentrations and dilution fixed; D shows back-calculation. The dashed 37 μmol/L line is the prescribed stock concentration; the interval is a model quantile interval.
